scenes.heading: Secrets & Environment Promotion
scenes.narration: Managing secrets securely and promoting changes cleanly between environments are two disciplines that keep data platforms both safe and stable.

scenes.heading: Secrets done right
bullets: Store secrets in a dedicated manager, not Git
Inject secrets at runtime, never bake them in
scenes.narration: Secrets belong in a dedicated manager such as Vault or a cloud secrets service, never committed to Git. They should be injected into your workloads at runtime rather than baked into images. Credentials must be rotated regularly to limit the blast radius of a leak. And access should follow least privilege, so each service sees only the secrets it truly needs.

scenes.heading: Promotion pipeline
scenes.narration: You build the artifact a single time so every environment runs identical bits. That same artifact deploys first to development for quick iteration. Once validated it is promoted to staging, which mirrors production. Finally, after a last round of checks, the very same artifact is promoted to production.

scenes.heading: Referencing a Kubernetes Secret
scenes.code:
apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata:
  name: etl
spec:
  containers:
    - name: etl
      image: myrepo/etl:1.4.0
      env:
        - name: DB_PASSWORD
          valueFrom:
            secretKeyRef:
              name: warehouse-creds
              key: password
scenes.narration: This pod pulls its database password from a Kubernetes Secret rather than a hardcoded value. The secretKeyRef points at a named secret and a specific key inside it, and Kubernetes injects that value as an environment variable at runtime. The manifest itself contains no sensitive data, so it is safe to commit to version control.

scenes.heading: Secrets in code vs secrets manager
scenes.narration: Putting secrets in code leaks them into Git history forever and spreads them uncontrollably with no rotation. A secrets manager centralizes and audits access, scopes each secret to the services that need it, and rotates credentials on a schedule.

scenes.text: Build once and promote the same artifact upward, while sourcing every secret from a managed, rotated store.
scenes.narration: The takeaway is to build once and promote the identical artifact upward through environments, while sourcing every secret from a managed and regularly rotated store.
